HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 100 °C

2. B — Glucose and oxygen

3. B — newton (N)

4. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

11. C — Producers

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hygiene During Puberty; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Safety in the Home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
